findings.description: The code opens a file using `fopen` without checking if the file was successfully opened.
The code does not handle errors that may occur during graph operations (e.g., `agopen`, `agnode`, `agedge`, `agsafeset`).
The code does not check if the graph operations (e.g., `agopen`, `agnode`, `agedge`) return `nullptr`, which indicates a failure.
